nodes.title: RoadRaven
nodes.notes:
Version history roadmap for the RoadRaven desktop app itself, authored via MCP for canvas focus/navigation UAT (2026-09-21).

Derived from `git tag`, `git log --oneline --decorate --all`, version-string history in `package.json` / `packages/desktop/package.json` / `packages/desktop/electrobun.config.ts`, and `.planning/ROADMAP.md`, `.planning/BACKLOG.md`, `.planning/v0.8.1-canvas-focus-PLAN.md`.

GSD Phases 00-06 (App Scaffold through Agentic Roadmap Authoring) predate any version tag — built on `develop`/`gsd/phase-*` branches, squashed into the public repo's `Initial commit`, and released together as v0.5.0. See that node's notes for detail.

BUG-3 — collapse state resets on structural edits
children.notes: Deferred — the owner parked this until the end of UAT (Phase 6 spike in `.planning/v0.8.1-canvas-focus-PLAN.md`, user decision D2, 2026-09-21: "stays out of scope; revisit near the end of development"). Root cause: every structural mutation bumps `dataKey`; react-d3-tree's `assignInternalProperties` resets `collapsed: false` on all nodes, so collapsed subtrees re-expand on add/rename/move/delete/paste. Do NOT re-attempt the `loadKey`/`dataKey` split (proven to freeze the tree); do NOT add `initialDepth`. See `.planning/debug/roadmap-collapse-keybind-regression.md` and `.planning/BACKLOG.md` (Phase 5 a11y BUG-3 entry, "Defer to v1.1").
